$comment: Hand-written notes for the generated Lua reference (scripts/kb/gen-lua-reference.ts). Each note was written after reading the call site or method named in `source` in the Build 42.21 code (revision 4a0e9546ec). Add a note only where the code makes the meaning clear; never describe behaviour the code does not show.

AddXP.when: Fired when XP is added to a character, on the multiplayer server and in single player; a multiplayer client never fires it (the call sits inside `if (!GameClient.client)`). Arguments: the character, the perk, the amount.

EveryDays.when: Fired at the end of GameTime#advanceOneDay, after the calendar has moved to the new day.

EveryHours.when: Fired by GameTime#update when the in-game hour has changed since the last update.

EveryOneMinute.when: Fired by GameTime#update when the in-game minute has changed since the last update.

EveryTenMinutes.when: Fired by GameTime#update when the in-game clock crosses a ten-minute mark, right after the erosion and climate ten-minute updates.

LevelPerk.when: Fired when a perk level changes: the last argument is true when the level went up (IsoGameCharacter#LevelPerk) and false when it went down (IsoGameCharacter#LoseLevel). Arguments: the character, the perk, the new level, the up flag.

LogLevelPerk.when: New in 42.21. Fired while a character's XP is being loaded, once for each perk whose loaded level differs from the level it had before loading. Arguments: the character, the perk, the level, false.

OnCharacterDeath.when: Fired from a character's OnDeath, for characters (IsoGameCharacter#OnDeath) and for animals (IsoAnimal#OnDeath), with the character that died.

OnClientCommand.when: Fired where client commands are handled: on the multiplayer server when a client's command arrives (GameServer#receiveClientCommand), in single player by the in-process stand-in (SinglePlayerServer#receiveClientCommand), and directly by the global sendClientCommand when it is called on the server. Arguments: module, command, player, arguments table.

OnConnected.when: Fired on a client while it connects to a server, after the world dictionary has arrived from the server.

OnCreatePlayer.when: Fired when a player is set up: after the game finishes loading (GameLoadingState#exit, for player 0), from the global initUISystem, and when a split-screen player is added (AddCoopPlayer#update). Arguments: the player index, the player.

OnEquipPrimary.when: Fired when a character's primary hand item is set, with the character and the new item.

OnGameBoot.when: Fired after the Lua files are loaded: while the game starts up (GameWindow#enter), after a Lua reset (Core#ResetLua), when the in-game state is left (IngameState#exit), and on a dedicated server during start-up (GameServer#doMinimumInit).

OnGameStart.when: Fired when the in-game state is entered (IngameState#enter), immediately before OnLoad.

OnHitZombie.when: Fired when a zombie is hit. Arguments: the zombie, the attacker, the body part hit, the weapon.

OnInitGlobalModData.when: Fired after the global mod data has been reset and loaded. The argument is true for a new game.

OnKeyPressed.when: Mouse buttons fire it too: left as key code 10000, right as 10001, any other button as 10000 plus its number (UIManager#updateMouseButtons).

OnLoad.when: Fired immediately after OnGameStart, from the same place.

OnNewGame.when: Fired when a character starts out in the world: from IsoWorld#init, from the global addPlayerToWorld, and on the multiplayer server when a client creates its player (CreatePlayerPacket#processServer, where the square argument is nil). Arguments: the player, the square.

OnPlayerDeath.when: Fired when a local player dies (the call sits inside `if (this.isLocalPlayer())` in IsoPlayer#OnDeath), with that player.

OnPlayerMove.when: Fired from a player's update in single player only (both multiplayer flags false), and on the multiplayer server for a remote player who has just moved.

OnPlayerUpdate.when: Fired during a player's update, with that player.

OnReceiveGlobalModData.when: Fired when a global mod data packet arrives. Arguments: the tag, then the table, or false when the packet carries no table.

OnServerCommand.when: Fired on a multiplayer client when a command from the server arrives (GameClient#receiveClientCommand), and in single player by the in-process stand-in (SinglePlayerClient#receiveServerCommand). Arguments: module, command, arguments table.

OnServerStarted.when: Fired by the dedicated server in GameServer#startServer.

OnTick.when: Fired from IngameState#onTick, which the in-game update calls. The argument is the tick counter as a number.

OnTileObjectAdded.when: New in 42.21. Fired on a multiplayer client when the server reports a tile object added to the map. Arguments: the square, the sprite name.

OnWeaponHitCharacter.when: Fired when a weapon hit lands on a character, just before OnPlayerGetDamage. Arguments: the attacker, the character hit, the weapon, the damage.

OnWeaponSwing.when: Fired when a character's attack starts (SwipeStatePlayer#enter), just before the WeaponSwing hook is asked. Arguments: the character, the weapon.

OnZombieDead.when: Fired when a zombie is killed (IsoZombie#onKilled) and when a burning zombie dies from the fire (IsoGameCharacter#FireCheck, #ReduceHealthWhenBurning), with the zombie.

OnZombieUpdate.when: Fired during a zombie's update, with that zombie.

isClient.note: True only on a multiplayer client (it returns GameClient.client); false in single player.

isServer.note: True only in the multiplayer server process (it returns GameServer.server); false in single player.

isServerSoftReset.note: True only on the multiplayer server during a soft reset.

sendClientCommand.note: Called on the server, it fires OnClientCommand there directly.

triggerEvent.note: Fires an event by name. A name the game has not registered is created on the spot (LuaEventManager#checkEvent).

changes: **Inside the classes:** the engine diff between the two builds counts 61 exposed classes with changed public methods: 184 new method names, 26 changed signatures, 27 removed from the class that declared them. Some moved rather than vanished: `getOppositeSquare()` left the door, window, window frame, thumpable and barricade classes and is now a default method of the new interface `GridSquareEdgeElement`. Because the exposer uses `getMethods()`, it is still callable on all of them (the class pages list it, marked as coming from that interface). Others are gone or renamed: `Core.getOptionFocusloss` and `setOptionFocusloss` are now `getOptionPauseOnFocusloss` and `setOptionPauseOnFocusloss`, and `IsoGridSquare.getDoor` and `getWindow` now take a boolean.

**Keys:** vanilla Lua moved to the new `KeybindId` class, whose static fields name each binding (`getCore():isKey(KeybindId.TOGGLE_SAFETY, key)`). The string forms are still there: `getCore():isKey(name, key)`, `getCore():getKey(name)` and the global `isKeyDown(name)`.
**Text:** `getText` and `getTextOrNull` take any number of extra arguments.
index.reflectionHistory: The patch notes never mentioned it. Our records date the change to 42.15; the oldest Build 42 capture we hold is 42.20, so the code we can show is 42.20 and 42.21, where it is the same.
